title: Typography / Berlin texture and connected headline
slide_intent: Use repeated words or an inserted symbol deliberately so graphic expression still supports a recognizable message.
strategic_value: Berlin lettering and a Schwelle within a phrase can make DB headlines distinctive beyond their typeface.
demonstration: A tower overlays repeated BERLIN lettering at left; a photograph supports Weniger STRESS and Mehr ZEIT separated by a red Schwelle at right.
practical_value: Compare decorative background type with an identity element joining words.

content_islands.name: Berlin field
content_islands.spec: Repeat the destination word behind the illustrated tower.

content_islands.name: Connected phrase
content_islands.spec: Align the stressed headline words with the red Schwelle over the traveler photograph.

reference_purposes.Expression: Type becomes a repeated texture and a headline composition with a red connector.
reference_purposes.Application: The pair shows destination and travel-benefit campaign treatments.
